verdict.rationale: Unit is API-first. Its docs say the Dashboard and the APIs both give access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance and operational data, and that companies can build directly on the platform via APIs, backed by an OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a sandbox that fully replicates production. However, no evidence states that every Dashboard action has an API equivalent, so parity is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, evidence that Dashboard-only operational/admin functions (e.g. compliance review, user/team management) are exposed via API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components, with control over their product experience and operating model.
An OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Unit API is available here
Unit's Sandbox environment is a full replica of the production environment — all standard API endpoints work exactly the same way.
